## RSU Unrecognized Compensation Expense

- **RSUs 2020**: $9,715,000 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Total Unrecognized Compensation Expense (RSUs)**: $34,804,000 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **RSUs 2021**: $6,315,000 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **RSUs 2022**: $3,458,000 (Source: documents/report.md)

## Percent of Total Unrecognized Compensation Expense Due in 2020

To calculate the percentage of the total unrecognized compensation expense due in 2020:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{RSUs 2020}}{\text{Total Unrecognized Compensation Expense (RSUs)}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{9,715,000}{34,804,000} \right) \times 100 \approx 27.91\% \]

**Source:** documents/report.md

**Note:** All figures are in USD thousands and are from the audited 10-K report.
